acip: RAB RIB CAN GYIS MTHONG BA'I SKRA SHAD KYI DE KHO NA NYID NI, RAB RIB MED PAS MTHONG BA DE YIN GYI, RAB RIB CAN GYIS MTHONG BA DE MIN NO,,
english: The one who sees the real nature—the suchness—of the hair that the person with the cataracts perceives is the person without the cataracts; it is not in fact something that the person with the cataracts is capable of perceiving.
